ops.title: Don't run the local gd-build docs build on every phase/commit — rely on docs CI; local build at most once when the docs phase itself lands
ops.body:
User: "dont waste time building docs locally every [time]" — during the codex-parsing phased build (2026-07-19), where AGENTS.md's "any public API change must keep the docs build green" rule would naively mean a local gd-build run per phase.

**Why:** The local docs build is slow (the Documentation CI run alone takes ~20-27 min; local is comparable) and the docs CI on push gives the same signal without blocking the working loop. Per-phase local docs builds burn wall-clock for no added confidence.

**How to apply:** In multi-phase work, do NOT run `gd-build build` locally per phase or bake it into per-phase implementer briefs, even when a phase changes public API. Let the pushed commit's Documentation workflow be the signal, and run the local build at most once — in the final docs phase (e.g. P8) before shipping the docs content itself. Related: [[docs-gate-is-gd-build-wrapper]] (when a local build IS run, it must be the gd-build wrapper).
